hypotheses.statement: Small tail-current errors shift threshold crossings substantially where current slopes are small; normalized current RMSE underweights the relevant local error.
hypotheses.test: Replay frozen39e predictions and save signed crossing shifts, local current slopes, residual at reference crossing, delta_t approximation residual/slope, and connected-event identity. Controlled tiny perturbations and time-grid phase shifts are diagnostic only. Test FIT-only crossing-band/derivative loss versus unchanged objective.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crossings are well conditioned, shifts are not explained by local residual/slope, and the matched temporal objective does not improve these errors across seeds.

hypotheses.statement: Residual bias in learned equilibrium u or update z produces incorrect slow recovery; gate RMSE alone cannot distinguish them.
hypotheses.test: Frozen39e 2x2 intervention:learned u/z,teacher u only,teacher z only,both teacher; also teacher-state reset diagnostic. Record current/timing per channel and coefficient errors along each trajectory. Teacher interventions never selectable.
hypotheses.falsifier: Neither individual nor joint coefficient replacement repairs the residual despite a verified replay floor; investigate interface/metric semantics instead.

hypotheses.statement: Stratified static V/Ca anchors do not guarantee coverage of recovery tails, transitions and rare initial-state histories.
hypotheses.test: Paired uniform versus FIT-only transition/recovery coverage, equal labeled ticks and updates; log coverage by time-since-transition, activity and initial gate state. New FIT seeds, no copying development trajectories.
hypotheses.falsifier: Coverage improves as intended but held development recovery/timing errors do not improve consistently.

hypotheses.statement: Remaining precision may exceed the tested shared trunk capacity or optimization budget, especially for weak currents; split heads did not test a width increase.
hypotheses.test: Current width versus doubled hidden width at same abstraction, paired data and labeled ticks; save increasing-budget checkpoints on each trajectory. Report actual parameters, wall time and resident inference cost, with matched-wall-time secondary comparison.
hypotheses.falsifier: Larger capacity or more updates reduce training loss but do not improve the predeclared per-channel and strict behavioral metrics.

hypotheses.statement: Some timing discrepancies may involve disconnected threshold crossings or numerical sensitivity rather than a uniform physiological delay.
hypotheses.test: Audit current39e traces inFP32/FP64 with same frozen weights and clock, connected excursions, perturbations and phase shifts. Keep original pass/fail; report diagnostics separately. Prior parent precision probes are not evidence for current39e weights.
hypotheses.falsifier: Signed timing error persists with stable event identity and negligible perturbation/precision sensitivity.

proposed_experiment.diagnostic_stage: Same notebook first replays frozen39e coefficients and crossing audits; no training or candidate selection in oracle interventions.
proposed_experiment.training_matrix: 2x2x2:baseline versus temporal tail loss;uniform versus transition/recovery FIT coverage;current versus doubled hidden width. Three paired seeds,8arms/24models. Current best39e is frozen reference. Factorial controls begin from scratch with matched seed streams to avoid confounding warm start with intervention.
proposed_experiment.budgets: Prospectively fix budgets after runtime preflight; save checkpoints on one trajectory, including common budgets comparable to39e. No threshold change, no posthoc extension motivated by development.
proposed_experiment.loss_contract: Keep successful39e tail objective in all arms. Define new derivative/crossing-band term solely with FIT teacher traces, capped weights and scale floors; calibrate weights on fixed FIT gradients. Exact numeric specification belongs in next preregistration.
proposed_experiment.diagnostics: Gradient norms/conflicts, clipping incidence, u/z probes, training/development gap, all-channel residuals, all72 development cases, regressions on previously passing cases, separate stress panel, finite parameters and Adam at every checkpoint.
proposed_experiment.selection: Freeze original strict quality thresholds and a prospective selection rule. Do not choose a different winner from stress or construct a per-case oracle ensemble. Any successful candidate still requires fresh independent confirmation.
proposed_experiment.compute: Vectorize independent models on one GPU only after optimizer ownership and update parity preflights; checkpoint/log backups outside runtime verified by SHA256. Report inference cost on identical workload and accuracy-qualified candidates.
